artboards.title: Proposed v2 — deliveries lead, faces attached
A quiet day, and an unloaded firm

annotations.text:
What changed from v1.

The byline moved onto the thing it belongs to. Wren's name and face now sit on the briefing itself, the way a byline sits on an article — not floating in the top-right corner of the page.

Deliveries lead, everything else sits below. Each one is a person handing you something, with their face beside it, rather than a titled panel that happens to have a name at the bottom.

An employee with nothing to report stays on the page, quieter and smaller. Silence from a named colleague is information; an absent card is just a gap.
